producer_query.fiber: D.A.filter (fun p => dist p first.deleted.1 = dist p second.deleted.1)
producer_query.required_new_point: c in fiber and c != common_actual_blocker and c != S.oppApex2
producer_query.known_lower_bound_not_sufficient: 3 <= (SelectedClass D.A S.oppApex2 rho intersect S.capInteriorByIndex S.oppIndex2).card

required_producer_outputs.name: third_bisector_carrier
required_producer_outputs.statement: c in D.A, c differs from the common actual blocker and S.oppApex2, and c is equidistant from the two deleted sources

required_producer_outputs.name: bisector_fiber_card_ge_three
required_producer_outputs.statement: the carrier fiber of the two deleted-source bisector has cardinality at least three

required_producer_outputs.name: third_interior_escape
required_producer_outputs.statement: there is a strict second-cap interior point outside both deleted sources and the saturated common selected row; its deletion survives at the common blocker and its actual blocker differs from that blocker
required_producer_outputs.consumer: pending global B1 blocker-multiplicity or row-cap consumer
required_producer_outputs.promotion_status: source-clean partial producer; does not imply a third bisector point

required_producer_outputs.name: global_shell_cap_no_m44_obstruction
required_producer_outputs.statement: a source-level shell/cap/no-(m,4,4) theorem whose output is one of the two interfaces above
required_producer_outputs.consumer: requires a separately proved universal lift

required_lift.statement: the producer output is derived from the full live B1 binders for every admissible carrier, not only from the named-local projection

notes: b1_live_normalForm supplies support equality, cross-membership, and the physical two-point intersection used by the local projection.
b1_live_exists_third_interior_escape is a source-clean narrowing theorem: its escaped point is not asserted to lie on the deleted-source bisector.
b1_live_escape_small_overlap is source-clean: it composes the escape with the selected-shell at-most-two theorem and records the escaped-shell intersection packet.
b1_live_false_of_escape_overlap_ge_three is conditional: it closes only under a separately proved universal lower bound of three for every admissible escaped point.
The latest source audit does not entail that lower bound; equal-center/same-support and distinct-center/at-most-two are the exhaustive source dichotomy.
The B1-direct-shadow SAT model is not a finite geometric model and cannot promote the live theorem.
The third-bisector smoke is a theorem-bank regression test, not a producer for the live B1 binders.

B1GlobalTransportContext packages the full live packet once; false_of_b1_global_gap_or_closed_terminal closes the third-carrier, fiber-card, and escaped-overlap arms. The source audit found no producer for that disjunction, so producer_theorem and lift_theorem remain null.
